222-527-955-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-955-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

574-1659-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a 1/1 green Snake creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1659-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

116-573-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-573-2645-3430.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3430-3995-6723.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
3430-3995-6723.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-2446-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-2446-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1636-4485-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-4485-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

1558-5471-7651.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Deal combat damage using Obeka, triggering its ability, causing you to get at least four extra upkeep steps.
Repeat step 1 during each extra upkeep step, creating at least four additional Treasures.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

240-2292-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3817-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-5921-5970-6633.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2366-2438-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2438-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

821-2173-5220-6794.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1263-2060-6701-6798.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2060-6701-6798.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

3129-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3129-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3129-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 3.

777-1690-2538-2585.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
777-1690-2538-2585.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Grim Monolith to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
777-1690-2538-2585.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

224-1772-3875-5233.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

628-2018-4050.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that is not a Human and does not have flying.
628-2018-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Repeat.

488-2478-4211-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites: One of either Mishra's Bauble or Tormod's Crypt must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-2478-4211-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

719-1486-3457.notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
719-1486-3457.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seeker of Skybreak ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4359-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3742-4251-4359-4452.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

573-1479-1659.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-1659.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Seed the Land, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Seed the Land trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

372-1922-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Pinnacle Monk exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1922-5913.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian and causing you to draw a card.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

628-2034-5523.notablePrerequisites: Defiant Greatmaw does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2034-5523.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw, adding {C}{C}
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Repeat.

112-2034-3490-4871-5375.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Witch-Maw Nephilim.
Witch-Maw Nephilim's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Clockspinning, putting a +1/+1 counter on Witch-Maw Nephilim and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
You may also target any other creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Clockspinning.

2464-3099-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
2464-3099-4222.description:
Activate the creature with Freed from the Real attached by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Leyline of Abundance's ability.

1972-3174-4691.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying {4}{U}, exchanging control of Vilis and another creature with an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Nekusar triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4316-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

678-2034-2882-3819-4221.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
678-2034-2882-3819-4221.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Living Plane and Infinite Reflection.
When the land enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land, adding {C}{C}.
When the land dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the land to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the land's trigger from step 3, causing you to put the land onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

401-2530-2842-3944.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-2842-3944.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Repeat.

1773-2427-2640-4050-4564.notablePrerequisites: Nyxborn Rollicker attached to Everflame Eidolon.
1773-2427-2640-4050-4564.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Everflame Eidolon, adding {R}.
Everflame Eidolon leaves the battlefield, causing Nyxborn Rollicker to become an enchantment creature.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Everflame Eidolon from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Everflame Eidolon for its bestow cost by paying {R}, attaching it to Nyxborn Rollicker.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nyxborn Rollicker, adding {R}.
Nyxborn Rollicker leaves the battlefield, causing Everflame Eidolon to become an enchantment creature.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Nyxborn Rollicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Nyxborn Rollicker for its bestow cost by paying {R}, attaching it to Everflame Eidolon.
Repeat.

1651-1961-3764-4680.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature.
The creature dies, triggering Summoning Station, untapping Summoning Station.
Resolve the Throne of Geth trigger, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Summoning Station and The Hollow Sentinel, untapping Throne of Geth.
Repeat.

4050-4151-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {1}.
Vishgraz dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Vishgraz from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Vishgraz enters the battlefield, creating three 1/1 Phyrexian Mite creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mites, adding {3}.
Repeat.

146-169-1849.description:
Cast Pact of the Titan choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times, paying a total of {0}.
Pact of the Titan's replicate ability triggers, causing you to copy Pact of the Titan for each time the replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Pact of the Titans, creating an arbitrarily large number of 4/4 Giant creature tokens.
You may then move to your combat step, and use the infinite Giant tokens to deal infinite combat damage to each opponent.

2882-4675-4694-5025.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4675-4694-5025.description:
Cast Spellbook by paying {0}.
Spellbook enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Spellbook from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
